name: Jump Drive
summary: Fast card version of Race for the Galaxy where players build a space empire to reach 50 VP first.
rules_text: Each player has an empire of development and world cards and a hand from a shared deck. The game is played in simultaneous rounds. Each round all players secretly choose to place 0-2 cards or Explore. Placing 1 development gives -1 cost discount; placing 1 world gives +1 card draw after paying; placing 1 of each gives no bonus; placing none gives Explore. Developments are paid by discarding cards equal to cost, possibly reduced by powers but not below 0. Military worlds with red defense are conquered free if your total military icons meets defense. Survey Team from center may be taken once per game as a development with 1 military. Colony or Military Convoy powers may allow a second world after reveal. After placement, score all empire cards for VP chips, placing chips under new cards. If any player has 50+ VP the game ends and most VP wins, tie break by hand plus income. Otherwise each player draws cards equal to income and discards excess over 10.
